title: DH5α bacteria transformation
author: Yoan Coudert
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bghijt4e
materials: Spread desired volume (150-350 μl) onto selection plate

steps.title: Add DNA to competent cells
steps.instruction: Add 1–5 µL of DNA to the DH5α competent cell tube and gently flick the tube to mix.

steps.title: Ice incubation pre‑heat shock
steps.instruction: Place the tube on ice for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Heat shock
steps.instruction: Heat shock the tube at 42 °C for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Post‑heat shock ice incubation
steps.instruction: Return the tube to ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Add recovery medium
steps.instruction: Pipette 450 µL of room‑temperature SOC (or LB) into the tube and mix.

steps.title: Recover cells at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour with vigorous shaking at 250 rpm.

steps.title: Store transformed culture
steps.instruction: Store the culture at 4 °C after the required incubation.
